description: Withdraw from the funded policy Safe or owner Polygon wallet. USDC.e withdrawals deliver bridged USDC.e on Polygon; many centralized exchanges do not support it, so prefer a self-custody Polygon wallet and convert to native USDC before an exchange deposit. Felix prepares one exact intent; the local owner key signs and the result is confirmed on-chain without exposing key material.

address.description: Owner address or confirmed allowlisted Polygon destination.

idempotency_key.description: Required durable workflow key, 1-128 printable ASCII characters.

resume_reconciliation.description: Set true only to retry the exact prepared request after reconciling an interrupted submit.

source.description: auto|safe|owner_wallet. auto selects the Safe when funded and otherwise the owner wallet.

withdrawal_confirmation.description: Email-confirmation proof for this exact withdrawal, returned by /v1/withdraw/confirmation/verify. Required by the engine for a new withdrawal preparation.

proof.description: Opaque verified proof; never a private key or email code.

name: withdraw
